name: Abraham Hamadeh
bio: a Representative from Arizona; born in Chicago, Cook County, Ill., May 15, 1991; B.S., Arizona State University, Tempe, Ariz., 2012; J.D., James E. Rogers College of Law, University of Arizona, Tucson, Ariz., 2016; United States Army Reserves, 2016-2022; staff, Maricopa County, Ariz., attorney's office, 2017-2021; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Nineteenth Congress (January 3, 2025-present).
